primary_prior_art.title: Improving Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search through Learned Adaptive Early Termination
primary_prior_art.finding: Per-query search effort varies; learned runtime features predict stopping conditions. Adaptive early stopping itself is established prior art; reported paper speedups are not WARM evidence.

primary_prior_art.title: DARTH: Declarative Recall Through Early Termination for Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
primary_prior_art.finding: Predicts recall during search and accounts for predictor invocation overhead; explicitly compares against hindsight ideal stopping points. No novelty claim for oracle stopping. A global mean-recall budget across discrete WARM prefixes is the proposed composition to test; its originality is unestablished.

gold_and_curve_validity.supported: Exact first-discovery curves for base-layer offer events under the archived gold instrument, at completed-expansion boundaries.
gold_and_curve_validity.gold_source: trace.rs oracle() loads exactly1000 baseline/all queries, exactly10 unique valid hit ordinals per query; navigation.rs writes those independent IDs as row.oracle.
gold_and_curve_validity.metric: Independent exhaustive cosine ranking using normalized Float64 rows/query and scalar accumulation, deterministic score-descending/ordinal-ascending tie break. This is the archived exact-ID instrument, not ANN website additive0.001 distance-threshold recall.
gold_and_curve_validity.why_events_suffice: Offer events occur only on first base-layer visit; expand precedes that adjacency scan; topology retains adjacency order. Membership of offered IDs in row.oracle gives discoveries without rescoring vectors.
gold_and_curve_validity.upper_layer_gap: diagnostic_entry records descent visits into evaluated, but diagnose sorts/deduplicates the combined upper/base evaluated vector at vertex.rs3484. NavigationEvent contains only base-layer offers/expansions. The archive cannot recover an upper-layer discovery time or all upper-layer estimate counts.
gold_and_curve_validity.restriction: The hypothesized policy stops only the same base traversal. Entry discovery is included; other upper-layer IDs are not credited unless offered in the base trace. Changing descent or retaining upper-only candidates is a different mechanism, outside this rejection bound.
gold_and_curve_validity.retention_relaxation: Any true neighbor discovered in the base prefix remains available forever to a free perfect oracle reranker, even if evicted by the serving beam. This deliberately overstates achievable recall and understates cost; it is not a serving implementation.
gold_and_curve_validity.source_arrays_not_needed: No new brute-force calculation is needed to construct these supported curves. Counter must hash and compare every row.oracle against the frozen independent oracle NDJSON before using labels. Corpus/query arrays remain pinned provenance, not a new search job.

preregistration.candidate_family: ef256 only, fixed for both corpus sizes before the discovery look; stop after entry or completed expansion. ef128 is a frozen baseline comparator, not a candidate rescue.

preregistration.row_mapping: Development surrogates for ANN GloVe100 high/perfect recall rows; corpus subsets and exact-ID metric differ from published full ANN pages. Current strongest comparator and actual final row recall are unresolved; passing.99 cannot certify a stronger required recall or any MATRIX row.
primitive_objectives: total adjacency-ID reads in completed expansions
total fresh base-layer row estimates, including entry/recovery seeds
preregistration.fixed_baseline: For each corpus size,floor,objective: minimum full-trace count among the two already-recorded ef128/256 cells whose full oracle-discovery mean recall reaches that floor. Retain which ef supplied each denominator. Compare oracle-retention discovery to oracle-retention discovery, and separately report actual serving-selected recall only as context.
preregistration.threshold: Reject candidate prefix family for that corpus/floor if3*minimum_oracle_reads>best_fixed_reads OR3*minimum_oracle_estimates>best_fixed_estimates. Integer comparisons, no rounding; equality passes necessary gate.
preregistration.classifier_gate: No classifier work unless both independent bounds pass for the preregistered ef256 family at.99 on both corpus sizes. Passing remains insufficient: require one joint allocation, actual final-row recall, retention/reranking and predictor costs, and unseen-query validation before policy acceptance.
preregistration.perfect_handling: Always retain independent1.0 results. Any query missing a true neighbor at full ef256 makes its1.0 prefix allocation infeasible. A.99 pass never promotes or changes a perfect row.
preregistration.infeasible_handling: If sum of maximum discovered gold hits is below required hits, output infeasible_within_frozen_trace and irreducible missing-hit count. Do not compute a finite speedup, lower the floor, widen ef, or call this a global limit on adaptive deeper search.
preregistration.tail_and_per_query: No extra per-query recall minimum beyond benchmark rules. Every chosen prefix has<=its original query work, so primitive-work p99 cannot exceed that full trace. This does not establish runtime p99. No tail/memory/build constraint is waived.
preregistration.frozen_relaxations: Free exact result retention/reranking, zero oracle-decision cost, no upper-layer gain credited, no row-score time conversion. Both baseline and prefixes use the same counted base-layer work boundary.
no_rescue: No classifier fit before oracle threshold
No conversion from unrelated Yi/Llama profile percentages

exact_counter_design.schema_reuse: Use the already corrected100k legacy header and10k rows/corpusRows header from navigation_headroom.py/packet_eligibility.py; verify raw hash,receipt hash,graph hash,2002 records,1000 queries per ef and stored/original-ID identity.
exact_counter_design.gold_check: Read pinned independent oracle NDJSON once; filter baseline/all; verify dataset,queryId,query ordinal,exact10 unique valid hits and exact row.oracle equality for every navigation record.
curve_construction: Begin after entry offer with its gold membership and one fresh estimate.
At each expand, add its full adjacency length to cumulative reads; consume all subsequent offers with that parent, checking first-visit/order, and add one fresh estimate per offer.
Emit a checkpoint only after that complete expansion; record total unique gold hits in all base offers so far.
Any recovery seeds before the next completed expansion add fresh-estimate cost; they do not create extra stopping points. Pinned E21 totals show one seed/query in these inputs.
Retain first/cheapest checkpoint for each attained hit count; a later identical hit count is dominated because both counted costs are nondecreasing.
Full-curve totals must equal E21 counters per cell; selected-result IDs never enter the discovery count.
exact_counter_design.dp: For a single primitive objective, each query option is an actual checkpoint with hits h and integer cost c. DP_i[m]=min over options o of DP_(i-1)[m-(10-h_o)]+c_o, with DP_0[0]=0 and absent states infinity; retain m<=100 for.99 and read m=0 for1.0. Answer is min DP_1000[m] for m within that floor budget. Cost-optimal witness prefixes are diagnostic only; do not train on or deploy them.
exact_counter_design.complexity: At most11 nondominated hit-count options/query; two objectives,1000 queries,101 deficit states/cell. No convexity assumption, LP rounding, greedy marginal sorting or parameter sweep.
exact_counter_design.independent_minima_warning: Read-optimal and estimate-optimal DP witnesses can differ. Their separate success is only a necessary condition for any joint>=3x allocation; never report their minima as one achievable execution.
exact_counter_design.outputs: Per cell/floor feasibility,max gold coverage,irreducible misses,baseline candidates/choice,exact optimum for each objective,integer3x checks; separate perfect status; all aggregate counts and full source/config hashes; durable full curves or witness hashes sufficient for root independent verification.
exact_counter_design.execution_status: No counter code or measurement in this assignment; root review/preregistration precedes implementation/run.

scope_of_rejection: A failure rejects only early stopping on the existing fixedef256 base-traversal prefixes with these generous oracle relaxations. It says nothing about deeper/adaptive beam search,new graph topology,new representation,or upper-layer retention.
risks: Gold-informed stopping is unattainable and illegal as a serving benchmark policy.
Average recall can spend errors unevenly; declared per-query constraints, if any, must be enforced in a real policy.
Fresh estimates/adjacency reads do not share a calibrated cost unit, hence no invented weighted total.
Successful optimistic counting is not throughput and cannot establish half-gap closure against an unmeasured matched competitor.
The archive cannot measure upper-layer first-discovery times or actual intermediate reranking costs.
